articles.summary: Stripe, the programmable financial services company, is powering a new Tap to Pay offering from HSBC UK, bringing payments infrastructure trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to small businesses through their bank.
articles.title: Stripe and HSBC power Tap to Pay for UK small businesses

articles.summary: Standard Stripe coupons apply a fixed amount or percent off a product. When your discounting strategy is more specific - price-targeted offers, BOGO, interval-aware discounts, or caps that follow your prices - you can customize discount calculation in Billing. Start with dashboard-authored coupons, or write a TypeScript script that runs during the discount calculation extension point.
articles.title: Billing customizations: change how discounts are applied

articles.summary: Claimable sandboxes are a primitive that unblocks agents to build and test Stripe integrations without having to sign up. Learn how they work and how we navigated security, latency, cost, and UX tradeoffs.
articles.title: Claimable sandboxes: Frictionless Stripe accounts for agents

articles.summary: We want developers building with agents to start on the best Stripe setup, and that begins with seeing where agents fall short today. So we built Stripe evals to measure that, and to identify ways to steer agents toward better integrations.
articles.title: Stripe evals: Measuring real-world coding agent performance

articles.summary: Stripe today announced that its Crypto Onramp powers stablecoin purchases in the new Samsung Wallet Stablecoin Account.
articles.title: Stripe powers stablecoin purchases in Samsung Wallet

articles.summary: You can now use natural language to create an investor slide deck highlighting where your business outperformed in the previous quarter, or build a custom dashboard to understand why your Stripe revenue changed.
articles.title: Analyze your Stripe data directly with your agent
